reviews.comment: Prof. Berna was an amazing professor. Her lectures and slides are long, but they are very thorough. The exam review is extensive, and if you do it, the exams are very fair. She really wants students to succeed. Overall, a great professor if you keep up with the material.

I've never seen a professor as caring as Dr. Hascakir, even though your grade is ENTIRELY based on tests, she offered makeups and really eased the path for students to do their best. Amazing lecturer, you have to keep up or YOU'LL FALL BEHIND TERRIBLY. The hardest thing about this class (beside the challenging exams) is her TA's grading, CRUEL.
